# Emotica - AI-Powered Emotion Tracker

> Emotica is a private AI-powered emotion tracking app for iOS that helps users understand their emotional patterns with end-to-end encryption.

## About Emotica

Emotica is a free iOS app designed to help you understand your emotions better. Using advanced AI and a privacy-first approach, Emotica provides personalized insights about your emotional patterns while keeping your data completely private through zero-knowledge encryption.

## Key Features

- **Emotion Logging**: Track your daily moods with intuitive emotion selection and intensity tracking
- **Private Journaling**: Write personal reflections with end-to-end AES-GCM-256 encryption
- **AI Insights**: Get personalized coaching and pattern recognition powered by AI
- **Trend Analysis**: Visualize your emotional patterns over time with beautiful charts
- **Trigger Identification**: Understand what causes your emotional reactions
- **Secure Cloud Sync**: Sync across devices with zero-knowledge encryption
- **Daily Check-ins**: Regular prompts to help build emotional awareness habits

## Privacy & Security

Emotica uses a zero-knowledge architecture:
- All data is encrypted on-device using AES-GCM-256 before any sync
- Encryption keys are stored in the iOS Keychain - we never have access
- We cannot read your journal entries, emotions, or personal notes
- Anonymous metadata only - no personally identifiable information stored on servers

## Technology Stack

- iOS native app built with SwiftUI
- Supabase for secure backend and authentication
- Firebase for anonymous analytics (no personal data)
- OneSignal for optional push notifications
- On-device AI processing for privacy

## Download

Emotica is currently available for iOS through Apple TestFlight.
